about: W10.F7: a decision for every open PR whose head is not in the train (npm run train:missing). in = a task or train brings it; rejected = it will not go in, and why; replaced = what carries it instead. A decision is about one head: a PR that moves needs a new one.
note: Lane g2-L2 (W10.F7): re-run against verify/train-7 @ af2d0d7ce5 — 724 open PR heads in the train, 64 outside it, every one decided, 0 stale, 0 undecided; #985 moved from 'pending' (not a valid decision) to 'in' via W10.G6. Before: Lane INT2: #999 (#985's first commit 643c440e0f, the plan sync + P0 DoDs) merged into verify/train-7 @ 6516a3586b, so #999 is in the train and needs no decision. #985 is marked 'pending' with its reason: its strict-WIP commit waits for the owner's WIP decisions. 'pending' is not a value the checker accepts, so train:missing and the repo-file test in trainMissing.test.ts fail on it until the owner decides (the check was not loosened). Before: Lane F8 (review 8): re-run against the F8 integration head 2cb1792f1d (13 F8 PRs #986-#998 merged into verify/train-7 @ eba3a0eaee). The five dependabot bumps (#160 #161 #162 #264 #325) were re-keyed to their rebased heads and are now decided by number, author and title; #985 (opened after the T8 push) is decided 'in' via W10.B12.
